name: Night Camp
summary: Night Camp is a 2D action MMORPG played in the web browser. Players gather at a camp lit only by its campfire, in a world overshadowed by the Dark Tree, and set out to fight monsters and bosses and to clear dungeons with other players. Each hero chooses one of five jobs (Knight, Mage, Archer, Rogue or Priest) and advances through second and third classes such as Paladin, Archmage, Ranger, Assassin and Bishop. Between fights, players level life skills such as woodcutting, mining, farming, fishing, cooking and brewing, refine and polish their gear, open shops to trade with other players, and team up in parties and guilds. The game is in a closed beta in Thai.
